speaker: veronica
text: At the town hall, Veronica presents your dashboard as 'a little something my team pulled together under my direction'. Your name is not on the slide. The CEO calls it 'game-changing'.

choices.label: Email her a 'quick recap' afterwards
choices.result: 'Great to see the dashboard I built land so well! Attaching v1 from 3 March for reference.' Timestamped. Polite. Lethal.

addEvidence.label: Recap email proving you built the dashboard

choices.label: Interrupt: 'Actually, I built that'
choices.result: Forty faces turn. Veronica smiles. 'Love the energy! Let's take this offline.' You are now 'not a team player'.

choices.label: Say nothing, eat the free croissant
choices.result: The croissant is stale. So is your career.

addEvidence.label: You remember the town hall slide

text: You notice the recurring 'Project Orion Sync' has vanished from your calendar. It is still on everyone else's. The meeting is about your project.

choices.label: Ask in writing why you were removed
choices.result: 'Hi Veronica, noticed I'm no longer on Orion Sync. Could you confirm if that's intended?' She replies: 'Must be an Outlook glitch!' You screenshot the glitch.

addEvidence.label: Email thread: removed from your own project meeting

choices.label: Show up anyway with a laptop and a smile
choices.result: Veronica: 'Oh! Didn't think you'd need to be here.' Three people saw her face do the thing.

addEvidence.label: Colleagues saw her surprise you joined

choices.label: Let it go. Fewer meetings, right?
choices.result: You gain 30 minutes a week and lose all context on your own project. Decisions are made. You learn about them from the intern.

speaker: veronica
text: In your 1:1, Veronica frowns. 'I never asked you to build the Q3 deck. Why are you working on things nobody asked for?' She asked you on Monday. In this room.

choices.label: Send a recap email right after
choices.result: 'Thanks for the chat! To confirm: pausing the Q3 deck you requested on Monday.' She leaves it on read. The server does not.

addEvidence.label: 1:1 recap email about the Q3 deck

choices.label: Dig up Monday's Slack message and save it
choices.result: Found it: 'can u do the Q3 deck pls'. Archived to a personal folder. Took 20 minutes of scrolling past cat photos.

addEvidence.label: Saved Slack: Veronica requesting the Q3 deck

choices.label: Argue. You know what she said.
choices.result: 'I think you're misremembering.' 'I think YOU are.' Nobody wins. You replay it in the shower for a week.

addEvidence.label: You remember her asking for the deck

speaker: kai
text: Kai slides over to your desk. 'Hey. That thing at the town hall was messed up. Everyone on the team knows you built the dashboard.'

choices.label: Ask if Kai would put that in writing
choices.result: Kai nods. 'Of course. If she does it to you, she'll do it to anyone.' Seniors with a spine: rarer than a working office printer.

addEvidence.label: Kai confirms you built the dashboard

choices.label: Vent together over kopi
choices.result: Forty-five glorious minutes. Someone from Veronica's team was at the next table.

choices.label: Thank Kai and change the subject
choices.result: Kai looks a little disappointed. You both pretend to read a spreadsheet.

speaker: veronica
text: Team building: escape room. Veronica appoints herself 'Room Captain'. The team fails with 4 minutes left. She announces, to everyone, that you 'held the group back'.

choices.label: Laugh it off, buy everyone bubble tea
choices.result: $47 well spent. The team likes you more. Veronica does not like that the team likes you more.

choices.label: Note down who heard it
choices.result: Five witnesses, one public blame, zero clues solved by Veronica. Logged in your notes app with today's date.

addEvidence.label: Public blame at team building, 5 witnesses

choices.label: Skip the drinks after. 'Client call.'
choices.result: There is no client. There is only your sofa. It is wonderful.

speaker: veronica
text: Mid-year review. Veronica rates you 'Needs Improvement'. Reason: 'low visibility'. You were removed from the meetings where visibility happens.

choices.label: Reply in writing with everything you delivered
choices.result: Bullet points. Dates. Links. Derek is cc'd. The rating is 'under review'.

addEvidence.label: Written rebuttal to unfair performance rating

choices.label: Accept it. Pick your battles.
choices.result: The rating goes on your file. Your bonus goes on Veronica's holiday.

choices.label: Cry in the pantry
choices.result: The pantry has seen things. A colleague hands you a tissue and a Milo. Cathartic, at least.
